notes: Separate loopback HTTP owner servers, one application pool per process, on one local PostgreSQL fixture; alternating paired runs. Nested driver query traces include separate upstream producer metrics for billing. Acquisition includes connection establishment and pool wait; after-acquisition includes network/execution/decoding. Scenarios with initial companion p95 >10% receive two additional 50-pair rounds, retaining all samples. Not browser timings. First measured request is not guaranteed cold. Small PrepShip list is a 3-row page over 200 rows; margin remains 300 + 10,000 historical. Portal datasets contain 30 and 3,000 rows.
